about: customer messages sent to a digital bank's customer support

intent_descriptions.card_arrival: a card that was sent has not arrived yet; tracking its delivery
intent_descriptions.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes in general
intent_descriptions.activate_my_card: how to activate a new card
intent_descriptions.get_physical_card: the PIN for a physical card: where to find it or it has not arrived
intent_descriptions.order_physical_card: ordering a physical card: how, where to, and what it costs
intent_descriptions.getting_spare_card: getting an additional or spare card for the account, and its fee
intent_descriptions.getting_virtual_card: getting or finding a (non-disposable) virtual card
intent_descriptions.get_disposable_virtual_card: getting a disposable virtual card, or what disposable cards are for
intent_descriptions.card_linking: linking a card to the account/app, including putting a found card back in the app
intent_descriptions.card_about_to_expire: a card about to expire: getting a replacement or new expiry date
intent_descriptions.disposable_card_limits: limits of disposable virtual cards (how many, how many uses)
intent_descriptions.visa_or_mastercard: choosing or getting a Visa or Mastercard card
intent_descriptions.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using Apple Pay or Google Pay, mostly to top up
intent_descriptions.card_not_working: the card does not work anywhere or is declined everywhere
intent_descriptions.virtual_card_not_working: a virtual or disposable card is rejected or does not work
intent_descriptions.lost_or_stolen_card: the card is lost, missing or stolen
intent_descriptions.compromised_card: suspecting someone else is using the card; freezing or replacing a compromised card
intent_descriptions.pin_blocked: the PIN is blocked or locked and needs unblocking
intent_descriptions.change_pin: how or where to change the card PIN
intent_descriptions.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted (which merchants or places)
intent_descriptions.card_payment_fee_charged: an unexpected fee charged on a card payment
intent_descriptions.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment the customer did not make or does not recognise
intent_descriptions.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: a wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card purchase
intent_descriptions.declined_card_payment: a specific card payment was declined
intent_descriptions.pending_card_payment: a card payment is still pending
intent_descriptions.reverted_card_payment?: a card payment was reverted, or the seller did not receive the money
intent_descriptions.transaction_charged_twice: the same transaction was charged twice (duplicate charge)
intent_descriptions.extra_charge_on_statement: an unexplained small extra charge (e.g. $1) on the statement
intent_descriptions.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit the customer does not recognise
intent_descriptions.request_refund: asking for a refund or to cancel a purchase
intent_descriptions.Refund_not_showing_up: a refund that was requested does not show on the statement
intent_descriptions.atm_support: where ATMs are and which ones accept the card
intent_descriptions.cash_withdrawal_charge: being charged a fee for an ATM cash withdrawal
intent_descriptions.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal the customer did not make
intent_descriptions.declined_cash_withdrawal: an ATM declined or cancelled a cash withdrawal
intent_descriptions.pending_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal is pending or not yet reflected
intent_descriptions.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: the ATM gave the wrong amount of cash
intent_descriptions.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate on a foreign-currency cash withdrawal
intent_descriptions.automatic_top_up: setting up or finding automatic top-ups
intent_descriptions.pending_top_up: a top-up is pending and the funds are not available yet
intent_descriptions.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fees for topping up or receiving money by bank transfer (SEPA, SWIFT)
intent_descriptions.top_up_by_card_charge: fees for topping up with a card
intent_descriptions.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up or depositing with cash or a cheque
intent_descriptions.top_up_failed: a top-up was declined or failed
intent_descriptions.top_up_limits: limits on how much can be topped up
intent_descriptions.top_up_reverted: a top-up was reverted or cancelled
intent_descriptions.topping_up_by_card: how to top up with a card, or a card top-up that cannot be found
intent_descriptions.verify_top_up: verifying a top-up or the card used for it (verification code)
intent_descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: the balance did not update after a cash or cheque deposit
intent_descriptions.cancel_transfer: cancelling or reversing a transfer or a payment sent by mistake
intent_descriptions.pending_transfer: a transfer is stuck pending; when will it complete
intent_descriptions.transfer_fee_charged: an unexpected fee charged on a transfer
intent_descriptions.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into one's own account (top up by bank transfer)
intent_descriptions.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: the recipient has not received a transfer that was sent
intent_descriptions.transfer_timing: how long transfers take to arrive
intent_descriptions.beneficiary_not_allowed: a transfer blocked because the beneficiary is not allowed
intent_descriptions.receiving_money: how to receive money or a salary, including in other currencies
intent_descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: a bank transfer is not reflected in the balance
intent_descriptions.exchange_rate: what exchange rates are used and how they work
intent_descriptions.exchange_via_app: how to exchange currencies in the app
intent_descriptions.fiat_currency_support: which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged
intent_descriptions.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards and currencies are accepted for topping up
intent_descriptions.country_support: which countries the service or card is available in
intent_descriptions.edit_personal_details: changing personal details such as name or address
intent_descriptions.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity; the identity check process
intent_descriptions.verify_source_of_funds: verifying or explaining the source of funds
intent_descriptions.passcode_forgotten: forgotten app passcode or password; resetting it
intent_descriptions.age_limit: age requirements, e.g. accounts for children
intent_descriptions.lost_or_stolen_phone: the phone with the app was lost or stolen
